Container.Name: garage-kit
Container.Overview: Garage kit: a household car-maintenance app (maintenance schedules and what's due, service history, symptoms, receipts read from photos, parts, guided diagnosis, an AI mechanic, a 3D garage) with an MCP server so Claude can use it. Self-hosted: your data stays in /mnt/user/appdata/garage-kit. AI is optional: Ollama on this server, the Claude API, Workers AI on your own Cloudflare account, or off. Not professional advice: verify before acting and do all work at your own risk. Setup and HTTPS options: https://github.com/Taylorshome/garage-kit/blob/main/docs/docker.md
Container.Requires: Optional: a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG), a Cloudflare Tunnel or Tailscale Funnel for public HTTPS, needed for Claude connectors and iPhone notifications.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web app.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, uploaded files, generated keys and automatic backups. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Household password
Config.Description: The one password everyone in the house signs in with (AUTH_MODE=password). At least 8 characters.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Your public HTTPS address, e.g. https://garage.example.com (no trailing slash). Needed for Claude connectors and phone notifications. Empty = LAN only.

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: 1 when Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG or a tunnel sits in front (trust X-Forwarded-* headers). 0 otherwise.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: IANA time zone for due dates and the daily reminder, e.g. America/New_York, Europe/London.

Config.Name: App name
Config.Description: Shown in the app and on the phone home screen.

Config.Name: AI provider
Config.Description: none = AI features hidden. openai-compatible = Ollama, LM Studio, OpenAI, OpenRouter. anthropic = Claude API. cloudflare-rest = Workers AI on your own Cloudflare account.

Config.Name: AI base URL
Config.Description: openai-compatible only, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1 for Ollama on this server.

Config.Name: AI chat model
Config.Description: The mechanic's model, e.g. qwen3:14b (Ollama). Empty = the provider's default (anthropic, cloudflare-rest).

Config.Name: AI vision model
Config.Description: Reads receipt photos, e.g. qwen2.5vl:7b (Ollama). Empty = the chat model / provider default.

Config.Name: AI fast model
Config.Description: Cheaper/faster model for first checks and email reading, e.g. qwen3:8b. Empty = the chat model.

Config.Name: AI API key
Config.Description: openai-compatible: the server's API key, if it needs one (OpenAI, OpenRouter). Ollama needs none.

Config.Name: Anthropic API key
Config.Description: AI_PROVIDER=anthropic: your Claude API key (console.anthropic.com). Usage is billed to you.

Config.Name: Cloudflare account ID
Config.Description: AI_PROVIDER=cloudflare-rest: your Cloudflare account ID.

Config.Name: Cloudflare API token
Config.Description: AI_PROVIDER=cloudflare-rest: an API token with Workers AI Read + Edit.

Config.Name: Sign-in mode
Config.Description: password (recommended), oidc (your identity provider: set OIDC_ISSUER, OIDC_CLIENT_ID, OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET), cloudflare-access, or none (anyone who can reach it can change everything).

Config.Name: IMAP host
Config.Description: Email-in (receipts, scan reports): a mailbox only the garage reads, e.g. imap.gmail.com. Empty = off.

Config.Name: IMAP user
Config.Description: Email-in: the mailbox login (usually its address).

Config.Name: IMAP password
Config.Description: Email-in: the mailbox password (an app password for Gmail/iCloud/Outlook).

Config.Name: Home Assistant URL
Config.Description: Optional notifications through Home Assistant, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8123 (LAN is fine).

Config.Name: Home Assistant token
Config.Description: A long-lived access token from your HA profile.

Config.Name: Home Assistant notify targets
Config.Description: Comma-separated notify services without 'notify.', e.g. mobile_app_my_phone.
